name: Tang Wei's Tang Champions

doctrine_behavior.ranged_priority: exposed commanders, officers, missile leaders, enemy champions, and immediate threats to Tang Wei
doctrine_behavior.survival_bias: preserve Champions, Tang horses, ammunition, cohesion, extraction lanes and command continuity while aggressively intercepting immediate threats

migration_provenance: Merged the two existing 50-man Tang Champion companies into one conserved 100-man formation. Duan Jin commands; Shen Rui is deputy. No personnel, mounts, ammunition, or equipment were created.
